craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. End-dash→colon (asking done, lesson released). Rejected: 'teach' verb for 'lesson' noun — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Through what drill, what rite, what lore art thou descried, O Master:
lesson me, and let thy favour light on me.
l4.sanskrit_cite: krameṇa karmaṇā kena kayā vā prajñayā prabho dṛśyo 'sīty upadeśena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mama

reads_against.argmap: By which course, by which rite, or by which wisdom, O lord, are you visible? → Show by teaching which course makes you visible; grant grace.
c1_essence: Course, rite, wisdom asked: show by teaching, grant grace.

l2.plain_english: Through what practice, what rite, what wisdom does one behold you, O lord — teach me, and let your favour fall on me.
